description: This file defines the XmlBody class responsible for serializing PHP data structures into XML format for REST-XML services within the AWS SDK. It contains methods for building XML bodies from operation shapes and arguments, handling various XML serialization strategies for different data types.

classes.name: XmlBody
classes.description: A class responsible for converting data structures into XML bodies for REST-XML AWS services.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs an XML string from a given shape and arguments.

methods.name: startElement
methods.description: Starts an XML element, adding namespace attributes if specified.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Dispatches to the appropriate serialization method based on the shape's type.

methods.name: defaultShape
methods.description: Serializes a simple shape by writing its value as text inside an XML element.

methods.name: add_structure
methods.description: Serializes a structure shape into nested XML elements.

methods.name: getStructureMembers
methods.description: Retrieves members of a structure shape for serialization, considering XML attributes.

methods.name: add_list
methods.description: Serializes a list shape into repeated XML elements.

methods.name: add_map
methods.description: Serializes a map shape into key-value XML entries.

methods.name: add_blob
methods.description: Serializes binary data as base64 encoded string inside an XML element.

methods.name: add_timestamp
methods.description: Serializes timestamp data using a specified format.

methods.name: add_string
methods.description: Serializes string values, possibly as an attribute if specified.
